title: EnderEyeControl
description: Simple plugin that overrides vanilla ender eye pointing location.
body:
# EnderEyeControl  

**EnderEyeControl it's a simple and straightforward plugin that overrides vanilla ender eye pointing location.**

**Commands:**
* `/endereye point <x> <y> <z>` - *Specifies the coordinates where the ender eye should point at.*
* `/endereye reset` - *Bring everything as it was before: the ender eye will point to the closest stronghold.*
* `/endereye reload` - *Reloads config.*

**Permissions:**
* `endereye.admin`

I hope this plugin helps you :)
